mod.description: Replaces the game's music with the HD soundtrack: every area variant, tempo and jingle mapped to the game's own sequences. Mod by Wesley Sieiro Takatsu de Araujo. Music composed by Grant Kirkhope (Rare); HD restoration by L. Spiro. The music is not by the mod author.
